Metrics We use binary classification metrics: (1) area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), and (2) the true positive rate when the false positive rate is 1% or 5% (TP@1%, TP@5%). To evaluate generation quality, we measure the perplexity (PPL) with OPT-2.7B. Generation diversity is measured with trigram text entropy (Ent-3) ... We also evaluate generations with Sem-Ent ...
